name: eist
label: Enhanced Intel SpeedStep
help: Core 2/Xeon P-state policy. Applied by coreboot after reset.

name: vmx
label: Intel Virtualization Technology (VT-x)
help: Enable or disable VMX on the next boot. This is not VT-d.

name: gfx_uma_size
label: GMA X4500 Pre-Allocated Memory
help: G41 graphics stolen memory, reserved before the OS starts. Applied after reset.

name: sata_mode
label: ICH7 SATA Controller Mode
help: This ICH7 has no AHCI or RAID. Changing IDE mode can prevent an installed OS from booting.

name: pata_controller
label: PATA / IDE Controller
help: Enable the ICH7 parallel ATA controller. Changes apply after reset.

name: hd_audio
label: Onboard HD Audio
help: Enable the ICH7 HD Audio controller. Changes apply after reset.

name: onboard_lan
label: Onboard Realtek LAN
help: Enable the PCIe port connected to the RTL8168/RTL8111 controller. Changes apply after reset.

name: power_on_after_fail
label: Restore After AC Power Loss
help: ICH7 policy after mains power returns. Previous-state restore is not implemented. Changes apply after reset.

name: post_success_beep
label: Successful POST Beep
help: One short tone at coreboot payload handoff. Requires a speaker connected to the board header.

name: nmi
label: Non-Maskable Interrupts
help: ICH7 NMI source policy. Changes apply after reset.

name: memory_fast_boot
label: Memory Training Cache
help: Enabled: reuse verified training. Disabled: full training on cold boot, including a cold reset after warm reboot. S3 resume still needs its saved training.
